$comment: Cover-sheet spec for the vendored AndroidX Glimmer samples. Unlike :samples-catalog's spec this one is NOT generated: there is no `sample-map.json` to generate it from, because that map is read from the `@sample` KDoc of the artifact the module compiles against and glimmer's AAR publishes no sources jar. So the inventory is discovery's own — every `@Preview` in the vendored tree renders and lands as a bundle preview. `compareWith` names the sibling glimmer-catalog: same library, same renderer, so the kit cell beside how you call it is an honest pairing here in a way it is not between the Robolectric and Skiko sheets.
title: Compose Glimmer Samples
